# DevelopmentalBrainTrajectory

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A framework modeling brain health as a dynamic trajectory from developmental stages to clinical outcomes, integrating temporal and topological changes in neural networks. Provides a longitudinal perspective essential for designing neuromorphic systems that adapt over time, mirroring brain development rather than static architectures.
